messages:
kate_sales: Urgent POC glitch with a UK healthcare customer. They pinned model 'redwood-9b-v2' for eu-west-2 but keep hitting "model not available in region" and occasional 429s. Demo in 20m, can we triage?
dan_se: Need tenant id + sample x-request-id and the exact request body.
kate_sales: Tenant `uk-health-12`. X-req `req_c9d8e7`. Request: POST /v1/generate {"model":"redwood-9b-v2","region":"eu-west-2"}. Error: {"error":"model not available in region","code":404} and sometimes {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":1}.
pet er_infra: (typo) checking.
pet er_infra: Logs show catalog returned no-replica for redwood-9b-v2 in eu-west-2 for this tenant. Also observed short shared-host bursts causing 429s around 14:02:11 UTC.
anya_sre: Short-term workaround: enable tenant soft-fallback to compat variant `redwood-9b-compat-eu` or route to Dedicated trial if they accept. I can flip soft-fallback now.
zoe_security: Customer asks about KMS residency and IP allowlisting. For Dedicated/Private we can do UK BYOK and CIDR allowlists; hosted pinned replicas in region require Dedicated commitment.
contracts-bot: Note created: HC-POC-789.
kate_sales: Please flip soft-fallback and add a temporary quota bump for demo window (48h). I'll update the customer.
anya_sre: Done: soft-fallback enabled and temp quota +20 concurrent requests for 48h. Monitor and report if 429s persist.
dan_se: For production we should propose Dedicated reserved capacity to guarantee pin + isolation. I'll draft a capacity plan and impact notes for the SOW.
kate_sales: Thanks all. I'll collect KMS/IP notes and include a ballpark pricing note (~$220k/yr baseline) and schedule follow-up.
